balls.text: makes room, Vinay follows him and the result is an inside edge for one
Gibbs has set off before the ball is bowled, Harris connects well and drives it down the ground, Gibbs is just not wanting to get on strike
full ball, driven past extra cover, Gibbs calls for two and they get it
yorker on the stumps, he somehow gets underneath it and biffs it over Gibbs, who again wants two, honestly he should be trying to get down the other end
full on off stump, he makes room and drives down the ground, Gibbs wants two and Harris comes back
and he's struck first ball with an attempted on the stumps, Bilakhia gets across to swing it over midwicket but misses and the low full toss hits him in front of leg stump
fuller this time and Bilakhia can only drive it to long-off for a single
excellent slower ball beats Bilakhia, PK just rolls the finger over the seam and the ball dribbles out and slides under the bat as the batsman swings across the line
shorter in length, again he advances and now swats it past mid-on
now he connects, and connects well, getting underneath a length ball and slamming it over mid-on for a flat six that brings up his half-century
superb ball, slows the pace and keeps it very full and straight so Gibbs, coming out, can only jam the ball back down the track
full and straight and Bilakhia clips it past midwicket for a single
again he drives a straight and full ball down the ground to long-on
searches for the blockhole but doesn't quite find it, Gibbs makes room and drives the ball down to long-on where Kohli does well to stop the ball
fuller in length and Bilakhia pushes it to extra cover and just sets off
takes a couple steps down and tries to pull a short ball but makes poor contact and the ball ends up dribbling between midwicket and mid-on
slower ball, much straighter, and he chips it over mid-on for one
bouncer outside off stump, Bilakhia doesn't expect it and pulls out, the umpire signals a wide for height
slower ball slides down the pads, Bilakhia cannot connect well on the pull but gets some glove on ball and it runs down to fine leg
four for Kumble! Venugopal Rao chucks it away with a loose inside-out shot, charges out but cannot get enough elevation and the ball goes straight to the man back on the extra cover boundary
wrong 'un on middle and leg, comes out and pushes it straight
smarter slower ball on a length, Gibbs drives past extra cover
short ball outside off and he gets back to pull past square leg for four

and Kumble strikes again on return thanks to an excellent catch from Pandey! He floats it up, gets some turn, Rohit makes room and dances out looking to go over extra cover for six but doesn't connect, the ball is up in the air for ages and Pandey covers a lot of ground on the run from long-off and dives forward to pluck a great catch with two hands
skips out and collects on the full, driving down to long-on
slower ball drifts down the pads, Rohit swings but can't connect
dances down but Roelof spots him and follows him with a slower, flatter ball which Gibbs manages to turn past square leg out to Kohli in the deep
good shot from Gibbs, making room to slap a short ball from off stump into the gap behind backward point, the man is to fine and thats a boundary
makes room and hits the ball in the air but well wide of extra cover
hits a good length and turns away, Gibbs waits and steers it fine
tossed up on a length, no turn, Rohit punches off the back foot for one
makes room and takes a straight ball on the full, its off the toe end of the bat but Rohit manages to place the ball wide of extra cover and gets a single
short ball slides down leg stump, Rohit misses, wide called
slower ball ends up a low full toss, Rohit makes a mess of the shot but the top edge goes over midwicket off the bottom of the bat and drops between three fielders
short ball and its gone for six! Praveen drops it short on the stumps, it sits up and Rohit gets back to pull, gets a top edge but manages six over deep square leg
better placement to a fuller and straighter one, just gets across and paddles it down to the man at fine leg for a single
tries a slower ball but its down the pads, Gibbs advances and misses
slower ball, pitched up, he pushes it down to long-off and runs hard for the second, the sweeper it slow and returns the ball to Boucher's end but Gibbs is safe
shot at last from Gibbs! Just gets across and uses the wrists to whip a straight ball flat over midwicket for half a dozen
slides down leg, Rohit plays a hard pull-sweep and can't connect
makes room and hurries to push a quicker ball past cover
shorter ball, Gibbs goes back  to pull but chops it back to Roelof
slows it up, gives it some air, gets some dip and Rohit swings it hard for an inside edge to square leg
makes room for himself and cuts the ball late and fine square on the off side, its beats two men and thats a welcome boundary, really well played and terrific placement
tossed up on a length, turns away from off stump and Gibbs drives past the covers, he tries another run but has to turn back and dive as a good throw is returned
shorter in length and this one is pulled out to deep midwicket
slower ball, straight, Gibbs comes out and slaps the ball hard but cannot time it and Kumble cuts it off to his left
full and flat on the pads and turned around the corner for one
rank short ball, makes room and slaps it over extra cover, looks a four but Pandey gives it all he's got, diving forward and saves a boundary, excellent fielding in the deep
shorter ball, breaks away, he pulls and misses
short outside off, Gibbs goes back to cut and inside-edges to cover
quicker and flatter down on stump, beats the bat as Rohit tries an ungainly paddle-flick, Roelof appeals but Simon Taufel shakes his head because it was missing off stump, but what sharp turn!
good ball on a length, Gibbs makes room and dabs it square
slows it up, lands it on the pads, worked straight to the fielder
flat on the stumps and he works it to midwicket
tosses it up, Gibbs makes room and gives him the charge, driving over cover but the ball lands safely and Uthappa moves well to cut it off on the bounce
slow ball down the pads and he flicks it to square leg for one

shorter length, nips back and cramps Gibbs, who plays it late and pushes it to the on side, Gibbs wants one but Rohit shoos him back, Kallis dives and flicks the ball back but Gibbs just manages to lunge his bat across the line safely
fuller ball, nips back, Rohit pushes hard off the front foot and the result is a thin inside edge down the ground just wide of mid-on for a single
length ball outside off, Gibbs pushes off the front foot past cover
short of a length on middle stump, Rohit turns the ball towards midwicket
Rohit comes forward and plays the ball back towards the bowler, tidy start after the break
Kallis pitches on a tight length just outside off stump and beats Rohit's forward defense
fuller outside off stump, swings away, no shot offered
nips back in off a length and he blocks it back, thats good bowling
good length just outside off, he comes onto the front foot and defends
straighter ball, slower too, Gibbs turns it off his pads and runs hard
shot but just a single, Rohit gets onto the back foot and drives the ball with flair into the gap on the off side and deep cover comes into play
back of a length on off stump, Rohit goes back and defends
slides down leg stump, ball skims the pads, they run a leg bye

what a way to get out! Kumble slides another wrong 'un down leg stump, its short and sits up to be pulled but Symonds cannot connect at all, the ball hits him under the arm, drops onto his thighs and then lands on leg stump to dislodge the bails
wrong 'un pitches straight and beats the bat as Gibbs plays over it, Kumble appeals but the umpire shakes his head, was probably missing leg stump, Gibbs gets a leg bye
thats just too short but Symonds can only pull a single out to Roelof at deep midwicket
short ball, hurries on but Symonds pulls it past midwicket for two
slowly floats it up outside off and Symonds pushes to extra cover
slower ball, tossed up on middle and leg and Gibbs defends
slider again, too short and he pulls it past square leg
flatter ball, slider, Symonds presses forward and is late on the shot but there's no appeal because that was missing leg stump easily
slower ball, on the pads, Symonds on-drives past midwicket
thats short and pulled away over midwicket to raise Deccan's fifty
flat ball on a length, Symonds waits for turn and then goes back and turns the ball away but Roelof dives to his right athletically and saves a runs, great fielding
pitches it up, Gibbs gets over it and angles the ball to backward point
and now thats edged smack between slip and Boucher! Good ball, hits a length and lures Gibbs away from the body, he defends and the deviation draws a perfect edge
makes room, Kallis follows him with a short ball, Symonds swats the ball through midwicket
shot man! Again Symonds backs away and smokes the ball past a diving cover and thats four more, what batting
dismissed! Symonds gets back and a full ball immensely hard past mid-off where Kumble dives with an outstretched left hand in vain
on the pads and he glances it around the corner for a single
bang, thats four! Again Symonds backs away to create room, Vinay drops the ball short but Symonds bludgeons it over extra cover and it lands just short of being a six
makes some room and throws the bat a length ball, miscues it, slashes up and over backward point and the ball drops in no mans land
pitches it up outside off, Gibbs lunges forward and pushes to mid-off
fuller on the stumps and he flicks it wide of midwicket for one

oh lord Dravid has dropped a sitter at slip! The man who has the most catches in Test cricket fluffs a regulation catch, it came at him at a good height after Symonds got back and steered a short ball right to Dravid, but its in and right back out, shocking that
another bouncer, quicker than what Kallis produced, Symonds doesn't get into position to pull but tries the shot anyways, the ball follows and cramps and beats him
good use of the bouncer, Gibbs goes for a pull and misses
good shot and good fielding by Uthappa at cover, Gibbs gets onto the front foot and drives a length ball but Uthappa tumbles to his right athletically
fuller ball and the movement draws an edge from Symonds' bat, he was waiting on the back foot and played at it late and got a thick edge between slip and gully
now he digs it in short to force Symonds onto the back foot, he hops up and allows the ball come on to him before dabbing it in front of cover
slower ball, fuller length, Symonds runs it straight to backward point
just short of a length outside off stump and Symonds doesn't disappoint, leaning onto the back foot and punching the ball between cover and point for four
better length outside off stump, luring Gibbs into a checked shot thats played a tad uppishly to cover
straighter ball and Gibbs gets the wrists into play, flicking it to midwicket
good length, movement back in, Gibbs defends solidly to cover

gone! Suman perishes to a straight ball on the pads, takes a step down and looks to flick that over midwicket but the late movement undoes him, the leading edge going high to the off side where three men converge but its Pandey from point who runs back and takes it
slashes a full and wide ball up over gully, it drops safely in the deep and third man runs across to his right and stops it from running over the boundary
starts off with a straight ball, to which Gibbs is coming out before and then turns it wide of midwicket for a single
slow bouncer just outside off stump, Suman thinks about playing but then holds back, arches his head and allows the ball sail past to Boucher
short ball stops on Suman who pushes it uneasily to backward point
comes forward to a length ball and drives hard to short cover, where Uthappa flings himself to his right and saves runs, a good effort from him there
back of a length and Gibbs pushes at, then checks the shot to cover
good length outside off, subtle movement back in, Gibbs defends
pitches wide of off stump and Suman plays it to third man for one
a tad shorter and wider and Gibbs steers it to third man for two
good stuff from PK, thats hit a good length outside off stump and Gibbs has to come forward and defend solidly to the off side
straighter ball, no swing, Suman dabs it to midwicket and sprints
short ball down the stumps and Suman hooks it over fine leg safely
good ball, full outside off stump, Suman presses forward and tries to tuck the ball behind the bat and the ball takes the inside edge onto his back thigh
full down the pads, Suman misses the flick, wide called again
off the mark now is Gibbs, opening the face and dabbing a length ball down to third man
even further down the pads and thats another freebie to Deccan
pitches full down leg stump and swings further for a wide
flights it up on off stump, legbreak, played to backward point
ooooooh, down comes Suman to a full and flat ball on leg stump and he gets an inside edge between midwicket and square leg
flatter, middle and leg and Suman comes forward to defend

knocked him over! Kumble takes out Gilchrist! Kumble maintains that excellent line, keeps it slow through the air, Gilchrist dances out and tries to club the ball over the leg side but misses the wrong un and the ball shatters into the stumps, good delivery, poor execution
slower ball, flighted outside leg stump, comes down and defends
fizzed up on a length outside off and Gilchrist defends to cover
length ball, swung wide of mid-on out to Rao and Deccan have won!
full ball outside leg stump, Uthappa swings and cannot connect, the ball brushes his pads and runs down to fine leg for four but thats not enough for Bangalore
fuller ball outside off stump, swung along the ground wide of mid-on and Rao fields down at mid-on, Uthappa comes back on strike
walks across and tries the paddle but he was looking somewhere else, not in position to play that, not a good shot at all and the ball rolls back down the track to RP
walks down and swings, cannot connect, the ball hits his thigh and rolls to the off side, Kumble starts off but gets sent back ... thats a dot ball
back of a length outside off stump, Kumble slaps the ball to cover and sets off, he has to then dive to make his ground and does well stretch himself

brilliant catch, and I mean brilliant, and whats more the batsmen have crossed! Vinay gets right across his stumps and paddles the ball, makes good contact but Harmeet Singh runs in from fine leg and holds a stunner inches off the ground, catches win matches, put them down at your peril is the  old saying and this young man has held his nerves excellently to hold on
not the yorker he was aiming at, its a low full toss which Uthappa flicks to Rao at midwicket for a quick single
amazing shot! Length ball, not what you need to bowl at this stage, Uthappa walks down and absolutely smokes that over long-on for six
pitches on a length outside off stump and Vinay pushes it to point and sets off, smart single gets Uthappa back on strike
thats the length, just full and searching for the yorker outside off stump, Vinay cannot connect and Gilchrist collects the ball
good shot under pressure! Harris bangs it in short and wide, Vinay makes room and slaps the poor ball over backward point and gets a crucial boundary
takes a step down, RP pitches it outside leg stump and the ball brushes the pads and rolls to square leg, the batsmen cross for a leg bye
much shorter in length, starts to angle across, Uthappa gets over the bounce and gently drops the ball down in front of backward point and calls Vinay across
slower ball, on a good length, turned straight to midwicket, dot ball!
serves up a full toss outside off which is pushed down to long-off
nerves! VInay walks across the sticks and goes for the paddle but cannot connect,  the ball rolls off his pads, RP swoops in and under-arms it back but cannot hit the stumps
too straight, Uthappa turns it past midwicket and gets a single
lovely dip, pitches and turns away but Vinay plays that rather well, waiting for the turn and then opening the face at the last second to guide the ball down to third man
flatter and quicker on off stump, Uthappa runs it down to backward point
they're collapsing! Ojha gently lobs it up on the stumps, Praveen swings across the line and the leading edge is taken easily by RP Singh running in from gully
tosses it up and Uthappa pushes the ball to cover again for one
slower ball, fuller, gets him onto the front foot and pushing to cover
tossed up, Praveen slashes over gully on the bounce to the deep
back of a length and Praveen drives it to the man at cover
gone, is that the game? Boucher goes back and limply cuts a short and wide ball right to Gibbs at point, right into his lap and Harmeet has taken another wicket
shorter of a length, very straight, cramping him for room and he can only push  the ball back down the track
backs away, then goes back and defends a length ball to Harmeet
slower ball slants back in and he pushes it inside out to cover
flashed and flashed for four to third man! Full ball and Boucher plays it late, edging it wide of Gilchrist and third man cannot get around to save that crucial boundary
pitches it up outside off and he drives and picks the gap at cover-point
gets over the ball and punches it wide of midwicket and mid-on for one
too straight and Uthappa gets across and works the ball down to Harmeet at fine leg, he runs hard and that brings up the 100 for Bangalore

hello hello hello, whats this? Excellent work from Gilchrist, collecting the ball that slides down Kohli's pads, he's over the line and doesn't get back in time so thats stumped and the stadium erupts as the sign flashes OUT on the big screen, chalk that down to excellent work behind the stumps from Gilchrist

gone this time and thats a crucial time to get rid of Taylor! Symonds dropped it back in length and Taylor's eye lits lit up, but he miscues the pull shot straight to the man out at deep square leg, who doesn't make a mistake
too straight and he turns it around the corner straight to short fine leg
good shot, just clipping the full ball off his toes out to the sweeper
short of a length outside off and he whips it down past midwicket
back of a length, pushed to extra cover and harries off, Rao collects from mid-off and nails a direct hit but Taylor was pumping furiously and makes it comfortably
fuller and straighter and Kohli just dabs that to point and sets off
good square drive, just saw room outside off stump and smacked it superbly into the gap at point, the fielders in the deep had little time to react
pitches it up, gets some shape in, Kohli rolls the wrists and plays it back
gets some dip this time and Taylor is comfortable just patting it back
better ball, slower and on middle and off and Taylor defends it back
super shot! Short and Taylor rocks back to pull that for six over fine leg
a fraction too short and Taylor dispatches that superbly past midwicket and the sweeper at deep square leg cannot cut it off, that was picked early and hammered
flatter on off stump, Kohli gets back and turns the ball past midwicket
slowly tossed up outside leg stump, Taylor shuffles across but cannot get any bat on it and the ball brushes his pads for a leg bye
too wide and he hits it hard off the back foot to the man at cover
good length, nips back, Kohli pushes it back from his crease
bowled em! Dravid gets too far across his stumps and cannot pull off the paddle shot with a man down at deep fine leg and his leg stump is knocked over
now he walks across and picks out the gap behind square leg
straighter ball, Taylor plays the flick straight to midwicket
pitches it up on off stump and he drives it down to mid-off, who is up
tidy stuff, Dravid gets back and works the ball off his pads
straighter ball, Taylor shuffles across and clips the ball fine for one
slides back in, he gets back and mistimes the ball to mid-on
short and wide and well cut out to the sweeper for a couple
comes onto the front foot and nudges the ball for a single
played off the pads towards midwicket for two
big shout as he misses one sliding down leg stump, the ball rolls to backward point
short of a length outside off and glided down to backward point
gets across the stumps to one pitching very straight and connects well on the flick, placing the ball wide of midwicket
now he goes short and wide and Taylor hammers that into the gap behind point, hit it hard and picked the spot he wanted, not a good ball at all from Harmeet
lovely shot that, just shuffled across and glanced the straighter ball very fine for four, really good stuff from Taylor
slides down the pads and Dravid cannot connect well on the shot
too short and Dravid pounces, punching off the back foot past cover
flatter and quicker, defends it back down the track and Ojha dives with an outstretched hand to parry the ball behind the stumps, the batsmen steal one
good ball, slow again, tossed up to bring Taylor onto the front foot and he pushes the ball square on the off side

wild slog and he's stumped by a week! Ojha persists with the fuller length, slows it up a touch, it dips and breaks away sharply from Roelof as he skips out and swings, Gilchrist just has to collect and break the stumps
quicker ball, back of a length and cramps him as he looks for the cut, not as much turn as he anticipated and the ball flies toward backward point
top shot again, just uses his feet and lofts that wide of mid-on for four
good placement from Roelof, getting back and steering the shorter ball into the gap behind Gibbs at backward point, he was looking to go straighter but adjusted well
fuller on leg stump and he eases an on-drive down to long-on
shorter in length, Dravid transfers the weight and tries to cut but misses
reaches forward and chips the ball just wide of mid-off
bye bye! Great shot off the pads, just cocked the wrists and walloped the straighter ball rows back over deep square leg
pitches and swings in late and he misses

nearly has him! Ojha slows it up a fraction longer, tosses it up on a wider length, Roelof comes out and then realises he's beaten, so stabs at the ball and gets a bit of bat on it, its wide of Gilchrist and backward point, the ball runs down to third man and then Roelof drops the bat, then gets it again, runs two but on the third the ball is back at his end and he harries straight down the track and dives into the stumps ... its all happening!
gives it some air to get Dravid again reaching out and driving to cover
good turn away this time, after it lands on a length that forces Dravid onto the back foot, he manages to pick the ball and dabs it to the off side
fuller ball with some drift back in, Roelof drives it past cover for one
slower ball, tosses it up, Dravid reaches out and beats extra cover

and he's got his man first ball! This one pitches back of a length and turns ever so slightly away from Pandey, who waits on the back foot and cuts but only manages the thinnest of edges into Gilchrist's gloves
this one nips back in from outside off and Roelof steers it to cover
straighter ball, Pandey patiently bunts it down the ground for one
another swipe to one down leg stump and he gets an inside edge
oh he's fallen over! Symonds fires it in straight, gets some shape, Roelof looks to clip it but ends up chopping the ball back onto his foot and loses his balance
swings at a straighter one and inside-edges it to short fine leg
good slower ball on a length and Pandey just pushes it back
good ball, right up there on middle and off and thats patted back
take that says Roelof! Powerfully struck shot, just saw the length and backed himself to go deep, slapping that way over wide long-on for half a dozen
good slower short ball follows and cramps Roelof has he backs away, goes for the pull and cannot connect this time
another crude swipe across the line to a short ball, doesn't time it well and the ball rolls to the man at midwicket
shorter ball now and he looks to the leg side and swings, Harris gets a finger on it and slows the pace as mid-off fields it
pitched up in the slot outside off stump and Roelof plays a superb shot to the slower ball, thumping it over long-off for six
and again Roelof stands back and thrashes at the ball, this time getting an inside edge that so nearly rolls onto his leg stump, Pandey is alert and calls for the single
swing and a miss this time to a shorter ball, he just thrashed at it
aims for the yorker and nearly pulls it off, swings through the air and Roelof has to adjust and jam the bat down in time to keep it out, really a good ball from RP
dragged on! Kallis gets into position early and spots the short ball but only manages to reach out and under edge the ball onto off stump, massive wicket that
fuller ball on middle and off, stays low as it angles across but Kallis is deep in the crease and gets the bat down superbly, just clipping that away past midwicket
short of a length and going across Kallis, who gets onto the toes and forces the ball away off the back foot to cover
full on the pads but he misses out, too early into the booming flick and the ball dribbles off his pads, had he connected that was going only one direction
slashes and slashes hard and gets it just over slip's hands for four, Kallis just threw the bat at that wide one and Rohit at a wide slip could not get a hand on it
change of pace, hits a good length, Kallis waits on the back foot and just eases the ball down to backward point with soft hands
pitched up, Kallis drives hard to Symonds at cover, who stops well
on the pads, too straight, and thats a signature Kallis shot, all power and placement and the ball whistles away between square leg and midwicket
comes onto the front foot and pushes the ball to extra cover for one
yorker length ball well outside off stump, Pandey reaches out to try and jam it down to third man but cannot connect, wide called by the umpire
straighter ball, Kallis gets back and turns the ball past midwicket
fuller ball on off stump, some shape back in, Pandey gets onto the front foot and pushes the ball off the middle down the track and knows he can get a single
pitches outside leg stump, tucked away out to deep square leg
shorter this time and he slaps it hard but Rohit dives to his right at cover
shorter ball gets Kallis up on the toes and he steers it square
pitches it up and Kallis drives hard but straight to the fielder
short and wide, wobbles away off the seam, Pandey thinks about playing but holds back, wide not called
length outside off, Pandey pushes straight to Symonds at cover
this one nips back in sharply and catches Kallis high on the flap, was going on high, Kallis is nearly cut in half and ends up with a leg bye to the off side
good shot off the back foot, Kallis gets up and punches the ball sweetly but Symonds dives and intercepts at cover, and he's got Gibbs backing up too
wider delivery moves away off the seam and Kallis shoulders arms
good ball first up, its quick and lifting from outside off stump and Kallis has a poke and misses
